SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

2. Which statement about Population distribution in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population distribution in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Population distribution in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Eastern Africa.

3. Which statement about Language groups in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Language groups in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Language groups in Eastern Africa.
   C. Explain Language groups in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Language groups in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

5. Which statement about Beef Farming is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Beef Farming never happens in Kenya.

   D. Treat Beef Farming as rumours only.

   C. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Eastern Africa.
   D. Explain Fishing in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Climatic regions in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.
   C. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Climatic regions in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Historic Built Environments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historic Built Environments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Historic Built Environments never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments.
   D. Treat Historic Built Environments as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Main physical features in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Main physical features in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Eastern Africa.
   D. Say Main physical features in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.

12. Which statement about Vegetation in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vegetation in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Vegetation in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Vegetation in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Eastern Africa.

13. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

14. Which statement about Culture and Social Organisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Culture and Social Organisation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Culture and Social Organisation as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Culture and Social Organisation.
   D. Explain Culture and Social Organisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

16. Which statement about School and Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say School and Community never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat School and Community as rumours only.
   C. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing School and Community.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Human rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Government Revenue and Expenditure and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
